body.text: Your draft was returned unpaid this morning. I am told there is nothing irregular about it and that the Treasury simply declines to honour your name at present.
The charge is {param:cost} a month. I mention the figure because you will want to know it and because nobody else is going to tell you.

I shall cover it from here. I am not doing it for you and I would rather you did not thank me; I have put my name to this and I am not going to watch it fall over because London has taken against you.
The charge is {param:cost} a month and I have no intention of finding it out of my own establishment. The funds will not last past the autumn.

options.text: and will not pretend to be surprised
and have no answer that will help either of us
and am aware of my own arrangements, thank you

options.label: acknowledge it, and say nothing you cannot keep
options.text: I have read it. I will not make you a promise this week that I could not keep last week, and I imagine you would rather have that than a pleasant letter.

options.label: say plainly that it is your doing
options.text: This is my doing and not London's, whatever the clerks told you. I would rather you heard that from me than worked it out.

tone.hateful: I shall write again when there is better news.
